# Espressif Developer Portal

> Central hub for ESP32 and ESP-IDF development, offering tutorials, compliance guidance, hardware support, and community resources for IoT and embedded systems.

The Espressif Developer Portal serves as the primary resource for developers working with ESP32 microcontrollers and the ESP-IDF framework. It provides comprehensive documentation, hands-on workshops, release announcements, and regulatory compliance information for building IoT and embedded applications.

## Key Topics

- ESP32
- ESP-IDF
- GPIO
- Embedded Systems
- IoT Development
- ESP-IDF Installation Manager
- Cybersecurity
- Regulatory Compliance
- Firmware Security
- Hardware Support
- CI/CD
- EU Cyber Resilience Act
- EN 18031
- OTA Updates
- MicroPython

## Getting Started & Core Resources

- [Developer Portal](https://developer.espressif.com): Espressif Developer Portal hub for ESP32, ESP-IDF, and IoT development
- [Hardware](https://developer.espressif.com/hardware): Hardware support, chip status, and SDK compatibility information
- [Software](https://developer.espressif.com/software): Software frameworks including Zephyr and Arduino support status

## Releases & Updates

- [Announcing ESP-IDF v6.0](https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2026/03/idf-v6-0-release): ESP-IDF 6.0 release announcement with key changes and improvements
- [ESP-IDF Installation Manager v0.8 Release](https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2026/03/esp-idf-installation-manager): ESP-IDF Installation Manager v0.8 with cross-platform setup and CI/CD
- [Blog](https://developer.espressif.com/blog): Blog covering ESP-IDF releases, compliance, security, and IoT tutorials

## Training & Workshops

- [Workshops](https://developer.espressif.com/workshops): Hands-on workshops for ESP-IDF, MicroPython, and embedded development
- [ESP-IDF Advanced Workshop](https://developer.espressif.com/workshops/esp-idf-advanced): Advanced ESP-IDF training on modular development, event loops, security
- [ESP-IDF tutorial series: GPIO get started - Part 2](https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2026/02/esp-idf-tutorial-gpio-get-started-2): GPIO input configuration, pull-up/pull-down, polling, and interrupts
- [Introducing ESP-IDF button component](https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2026/02/component-introduction-button): ESP-IDF button component guide with GPIO event detection and debouncing

## Compliance & Security

- [Understanding the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)](https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2026/03/esp32-cra-compliance): EU CRA requirements for ESP32-based products and manufacturer obligations
- [RED DA Assessment Tool: Cybersecurity Compliance](https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2026/03/red_da_assessment_tool_overview): RED DA Assessment Tool for ESP32 EN 18031 compliance documentation
- [Staying Ahead with ESP32 Security Updates](https://developer.espressif.com/blog/2026/03/esp32-security-updates): ESP32 firmware security maintenance, OTA updates, and compliance tools

## Events & Community

- [Events](https://developer.espressif.com/events): Espressif events including Embedded World 2026 and DevCon conferences
- [Embedded World 2026](https://developer.espressif.com/events/embedded-world-2026): Espressif at Embedded World 2026 in Nuremberg with live demos
